purpose: Pre-search contract for a separately labelled supplementary nonpromotional replay; strict confirmatory validation remains failed.

diagnostic_document.required_known_pair_assertion: known_qrels_match_frozen must be true only after independent derivation and explicit uncertainty adjudication, never by converting every mismatch automatically to U
diagnostic_document.corpora: Same three seed/path/SHA/count180/record-ID-hash fields as the strict contract; answerability is reported truthfully and is not the same as full validation.
diagnostic_document.coverage: Each seed has all13500 query/document pairs: known integer grades plus explicit U pairs. All540 manual record reviews and75 query-equivalence reviews remain preserved.

validated_qrels_row.grade: integer0..3 equal to frozen expected grade when independently validated; literal U for uncertainty-mask pairs

uncertainty_mask_row.intent_id: registered intent ID; applies to all its paraphrase queries
uncertainty_mask_row.evidence: preserved actual-text/reviewer artifact reference, where available

execution_policy.reason: The frozen confirmatory validation failed; unknown labels cannot be repaired by moving records outside their frozen claims or narrowing queries after generation.

hard_rules: Default strict gate rejects the incomplete document; no passed strict manifest is fabricated.
Supplementary execution requires an explicit diagnostic mode flag, independently produced document, mask, policy and parent approval before any benchmark embedding or retrieval.
Keep all75 target queries, criteria, proposed qrels, three seeds, eight systems and parameters unchanged.
Never coerce U to zero. A point graded metric is undefined if any U can affect its full-corpus IDCG or exact precision.
Known-only family means are descriptive and use their actual count, not the frozen eight-family primary label.
If sensitivity is shown, enumerate allowed grades0/1/2/3 for uncertainty units, recompute full IDCG consistently, and disclose bounds/assumptions. Never select an assignment to promote a system.
All outcomes force recommendation C. No A/B or production adoption claim is available, even if every descriptive comparison improves.
Finalize and hash the mask/policy/approval before the first target-query embedding; no subsequent query/label/metadata repairs or weight selection.
